about_the_game:
Crystalstone Chronicles is a turn-based strategy game that blends inventory management, loot grinding, and light roguelike elements.

On the fractured continent of Aetheria, a deep abyssal corruption is silently spreading from beneath the earth. This ancient darkness twists all it touches, turning living creatures into bloodthirsty monsters. The only force capable of resisting the corruption lies within magical gemstones scattered across the world—relics of an ancient age, brimming with pure, untainted energy.
These gemstones not only grant elemental control and physical empowerment, but can also be fused to forge ultimate weapons against the abyss.
“The brighter the gem, the darker the shadow it casts.” — Inscription from an unknown monument

Core Gameplay: The Eternal Dance of Strategy and Deckbuilding
• Always Ready for Battle: Turn-based combat gives you time to think, experiment, and refine your gemstone combinations. Failed? Try again. Every attempt brings you closer to the perfect build.
• Infinite Possibilities: Defeat enemies to collect gold and gemstone loot, steadily expanding your arsenal. Fire, Frost, Lightning, Life, Shadow… Hundreds of gemstones await your mastery and refinement.
• Cunning Foes: Each enemy comes with unique skills and mechanics—some devour your gems, some evolve over time, others reflect your attacks. Study their weaknesses and devise the ultimate counter-strategies.
• The Thrill of Overwhelming Power: With enough patience, you will eventually forge a gemstone combination capable of devastating all enemies.

A Tactical Feast of Endless Combinations
• Over 400 beautifully crafted gemstones
• Deep strategic deckbuilding system
• 40+ preset decks, each with unique traits and skill synergies
• Relic system offering additional buffs and special effects to speed up your build
All of these come together to help you craft your ultimate combination and achieve final victory.
